subject: Co-engineering sandbox sprint for LangChain / LlamaIndex trace connector
messages:
From: Ari Chen <ari@bridgeworkslabs.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Co-engineering sprint proposal: LangChain + LlamaIndex trace connector

Hey Vanessa —

Thanks again for the intro call last week. BridgeWorks would love to run a short co-engineering sandbox sprint with Redwood to validate a first-class connector that preserves tracing and token attribution when apps use LangChain and LlamaIndex SDKs. High-level ask: 2-week paired sprint in a shared sandbox (our staging + Redwood test tenancy) to ship a minimal reference connector and an example app.

Proposed success criteria (draft):
- LangChain agent + Redwood runtime: end-to-end trace propagation and request/response metadata preserved in Redwood Console.
- LlamaIndex integration: document ingestion -> query -> traced tokens showing model variant and pricing attribution.
- Sample app (notebook + small web demo) that exercises streaming + function/tool calls.
- Basic perf sanity: p95 latency within your recommended baseline for a 512-token response.

We sketched an MVP outline and attached it (bridgeworks-mvp-outline.pdf).

Questions for you to confirm before we kick off:
1) Which SDK versions should we target for LangChain / LlamaIndex?
2) Any required sequence length / KV cache behavior we should account for?
3) Preferred auth method for the sandbox (service token vs. temporary API key)?

If that looks reasonable, can we plan a kickoff next Wednesday (22nd) for a 30–45m scoping call? I can loop in our engineer (CloudEdge DevOps) who will run the sandbox infra.

Thanks — Ari
Ari Chen
Head of Integrations, BridgeWorks Labs
ari@bridgeworkslabs.com

Attachment: bridgeworks-mvp-outline.pdf (application/pdf, 148 KB)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ari Chen <ari@bridgeworkslabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Co-engineering sprint proposal: LangChain + LlamaIndex trace connector

Ari — thanks for the clear summary and the outline. We’re excited to partner on this; the plan aligns well with what our ISV partnerships team wants to validate. Quick answers up front:
- Target LangChain: v0.1.34+ (we support the new callback/trace hooks), LlamaIndex: v0.9.x.
- KV cache: assume cold-start on first run; we’ll document interactions with Redwood’s prefix/KV caching in the sandbox checklist.
- Auth: temporary API keys scoped to the sandbox are easiest for visibility; we can issue short-lived tokens for BridgeWorks engineers.

Proposed next steps before kickoff:
- We need a short mutual action plan (MAP) with owners and acceptance criteria. If you can share an editable MAP we’ll fill in Redwood responsibilities.
- Access: please provide the email(s) you want keys for (CloudEdge DevOps OK).
- Test data: please attach a small docset for the demo (5–10 docs) and a sample prompt set.

I’ve attached a sandbox checklist our integrations team uses (redwood-sandbox-checklist.xlsx). Let’s do Wed 22nd at 10am PT for the kickoff — does that work for your team?

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwoodinference.com
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-sandbox-checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 22 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ari Chen <ari@bridgeworkslabs.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 09:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Co-engineering sprint proposal: LangChain + LlamaIndex trace connector

On Tue, Dec 15, 2026 at 10:12 AM Ari Chen <ari@bridgeworkslabs.com> wrote:
> We sketched an MVP outline and attached it (bridgeworks-mvp-outline.pdf).

Thanks for the outline — pulling together a few notes from product/solutions so we have measurable outcomes for the MAP:
- Business success metrics (we’ll own tracking in Redwood Console): number of traced requests; % of requests with complete attribution (user_id/model_variant/prompt_hash); time-to-onboard (days to first successful trace).
- Quality gate: automated evals with a 20-sample prompt suite (we’ll help create).
- Operational SLOs: p95 latency baseline (we’ll start with 600ms for short flows) and error budget for the sandbox run.

Soojin — quick tech points you can add if helpful.

—Marissa


From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800

Vanessa / Ari — a couple of engineering notes from runtime/telemetry:
- Trace propagation: we prefer a single header X-Redwood-Trace that can be passed through LangChain callbacks and LlamaIndex query flow. Confirming BridgeWorks can attach/pass that header.
- Token attribution: for multi-call flows (e.g., agent loop + tool calls) we need to preserve per-call model metadata in the trace span; recommend instrumenting the LangChain callback middleware and LlamaIndex retriever wrapper.
- KV cache interaction: if BridgeWorks enables local caching on their side, we’ll need to reconcile TTLs with Redwood KV prefix caching to avoid double-caching and attribution gaps.
- SDK notes: please target consumer SDK builds that include our trace hook (we’ll share a patch branch if you want to instrument quickly).

I’ll draft minimal engineering tasks and drop them into the MAP before kickoff. CC Jonas for infra-fleet expectations.

—Soojin

From: Ari Chen <ari@bridgeworkslabs.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>, CloudEdge DevOps <devops@cloudedge.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Co-engineering sandbox sprint for LangChain / LlamaIndex trace connector

Vanessa / team — great notes, and thanks for the quick alignment.

We updated the MAP with owners, milestones, and a small test matrix (attached: mutual_action_plan_v2.xlsx). Highlights:
- Week 1: connector scaffolding + LangChain callback integration (BridgeWorks eng + Redwood runtime pairing).
- Week 2: LlamaIndex retriever instrumentation + sample app + telemetry verification.
- Deliverables: merged connector PR in our repo, sample notebook demo, and a Redwood Console trace dashboard with sample spans.

We’ve provided CloudEdge DevOps emails for token issuance (devops@cloudedge.ai). For the paired sessions, our engineers are available 9am–1pm PT most days next week; let us know windows that work for Redwood engs.

Per your ask, we included small test data and a prompt set in the shared Drive link. Please review the MAP and add Redwood owners for: SDK patch review, trace dashboard, and perf regression checks. If that looks good, we can consider this MAP as the kickoff artifact and start the sandbox access process.

Thanks — Ari
